discoveries.name: Apollo Lunar Module
discoveries.purpose: Land a crew on the Moon and return them to lunar orbit.
discoveries.scientific_contribution: Enabled the first human landing and surface field exploration on another world.
discoveries.instruments: Descent engine, ascent engine, landing gear, fuel tanks
discoveries.historical_description: The Apollo Lunar Module was the part of the spacecraft that actually touched the lunar surface. It used a descent engine to slow from lunar orbit and a separate ascent engine to leave the Moon after exploration.
discoveries.educational_challenge: Which task best matches the purpose of the Lunar Module?
answers: Carry astronauts to the Moon's surface and back to lunar orbit
Relay radio signals between Earth and Mars

discoveries.name: Lunar Laser Retroreflector
discoveries.purpose: Reflect laser beams sent from Earth to measure the distance between Earth and the Moon.
discoveries.scientific_contribution: Provided a stable reference for precision lunar ranging and Earth-Moon distance measurements.
discoveries.historical_description: The retroreflectors were placed on the lunar surface so that lasers from Earth could bounce back. Their precise return signal helped scientists measure the Moon's distance and study the dynamics of Earth-Moon motion.
discoveries.educational_challenge: Why do scientists value a lunar retroreflector?
answers: It stores sunlight for later use at night
It returns laser beams so distance can be measured precisely
It makes the Moon glow brighter
It acts as a backup navigation system for Earth's satellites

discoveries.name: ALSEP Scientific Package
discoveries.purpose: Leave scientific instruments on the Moon to study seismic activity, heat flow, and the lunar environment.
discoveries.scientific_contribution: Advanced our understanding of lunar geology, surface conditions, and scientific measurement from a robotic outpost on the Moon.
discoveries.instruments: Seismometers, instruments for heat flow, solar wind measurements, and other lunar science tools
discoveries.engineering_principle: Autonomous surface science recording over long durations
discoveries.historical_description: Apollo astronauts deployed ALSEP instrument packages that kept collecting data after they returned to orbit. These experiments helped scientists learn how the Moon's surface and interior responded to the environment around it.
discoveries.educational_challenge: What was the main role of the ALSEP package?
answers: To build a permanent lunar base
To record scientific measurements while left on the lunar surface
To power the lunar module engines
To transmit live television from Earth
